intro.text: We are a pioneering gene editing company dedicated to developing potentially transformative genomic medicines to treat a broad range of serious diseases. The promise of genomic medicines is supported by the advancing knowledge of the human genome and by harnessing the progress in technologies for cell therapy, gene therapy, and, most recently, gene editing. We believe this progress sets the stage for us to create medicines with the potential to have a durable benefit for patients. Our core capability in gene editing uses the technology known as CRISPR (clustered, regularly interspaced, short palindromic repeats) to allow us to create molecules that efficiently and specifically edit DNA. Our mission is to translate the promise of gene editing into a broad class of differentiated, transformational medicines for previously untreatable diseases.

net.text: The use of cash in all periods resulted primarily from our net losses adjusted for non-cash charges and changes in components of working capital.

ocf.heading: Net Cash Used in Operating Activities
ocf.text:
The use of cash in all periods resulted primarily from our net losses adjusted for non-cash charges and changes in components of working capital.

Net cash used in operating activities was approximately $210.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, which primarily consisted of operating expenses that related to increasing our research efforts, the progression of clinical and manufacturing activities in support of our former reni-cel program and supporting business operations.

Net cash used in operating activities was approximately $132.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2023, which primarily consisted of operating expenses related to the focused progression of clinical and manufacturing activities in support of our former reni-cel program, sublicense and license fees, and supporting business operations.

sbc.text: • employee-related expenses including salaries, benefits, and stock-based compensation expense;

wc.text: The use of cash in all periods resulted primarily from our net losses adjusted for non-cash charges and changes in components of working capital.

capex.text: Net cash provided by investing activities was approximately $162.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily related to maturities of marketable securities of $257.2 million. This was offset by $86.2 million of purchases of marketable securities and purchases of property and equipment of $8.8 million.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text:
To date, we have not generated any revenue from product sales and we do not expect to generate any revenue from product sales for the foreseeable future.

In connection with our collaboration with BMS, we have received an aggregate of $146.5 million in payments, which have primarily consisted of the initial upfront and amendment payments, development milestone payments and research funding support. We no longer receive research funding support. During the year ended December 31, 2024, we recognized $18.1 million of revenue related to our collaboration with BMS of which $6.5 million was previously deferred revenue. As of December 31, 2024, we had $50.2 million of deferred revenue related to BMS, of which $50.2 million is classified as long-term on our consolidated balance sheet. Under this collaboration, we will recognize revenue upon delivery of option packages to BMS or when milestones are achieved. As such, we expect that our revenue will fluctuate from quarter-to-quarter and year-to-year as a result of the timing of when these events occur.

Pursuant to the license agreement with Vertex, we received a $50.0 million upfront cash payment in the fourth quarter of 2023 upon execution of the agreement and the 2024 annual license fee of $10.0 million in the first quarter of 2024.

ga.text: General and administrative expenses consist primarily of salaries and other related costs, including stock-based compensation for personnel in executive, finance, investor relations, business development, legal, corporate affairs, information technology, facilities, and human resource functions. Other significant costs include corporate facility costs not otherwise included in research and development expenses, legal fees related to intellectual property and corporate matters, and fees for accounting and consulting services.

nonop.text: For the year ended December 31, 2025, other income (expense), net consisted primarily of interest income on cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities as well as interest expense accretion related to the liability for the sale of future revenues. For the year ended December 31, 2024, other income (expense), net was primarily attributable to interest income and accretion of discounts associated with marketable securities.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text:
To date, we have not generated any revenue from product sales and we do not expect to generate any revenue from product sales for the foreseeable future.

In connection with our collaboration with BMS, we have received an aggregate of $159.0 million in payments, which have primarily consisted of the initial upfront and amendment payments, development milestone payments, research funding support, and certain opt-in fees. We no longer receive research funding support. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized $23.2 million of revenue related to our collaboration with BMS of which $9.7 million was previously deferred revenue. As of December 31, 2025, we had $40.5 million of deferred revenue related to BMS, all of which is classified as long-term deferred revenue on our consolidated balance sheet. Under this collaboration, we recognize revenue upon delivery of option packages to BMS or upon receipt of development milestone payments.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
